name: Dark Fate reduces Crow's Harvest cost and Reliquary of the Lost cooldown
contract: Dark Fate 504037 is a passive SpellMod: Effect0 (SPELLMOD_COST) carries SpellFamilyFlags[1]=2097152, matching Crow's Harvest 504537's own SpellFamilyFlags[0]=2097152, base points -101 (raw -100). Effect1 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN) carries SpellFamilyFlags[1]=32 (dword index 3), matching Reliquary of the Lost 500631's SpellFamilyFlags[0]=32, base points -10001 (raw -10000). Both are native, generic SpellMod ops (Unit.cpp/Spell.cpp ApplySpellMod) requiring no CoA-specific code; issue #1909 reported no handler exists, which this proves false for both halves of the tooltip.

steps.label: Crow's Harvest cost unmodified before the talent
Reliquary of the Lost cooldown unmodified before the talent
Dark Fate aura settles on the caster
Crow's Harvest costs 100 less Runic Power
Reliquary of the Lost cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds
